agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a pre-freeze attainability/satisfiability certificate decides constructibility before an EXECUTE cycle is spent; an empty sampling frame is a control failure, not evidence about the scientific question.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): when comparators sit at a correctness ceiling, no treatment effect is identifiable regardless of sample size, so a dynamic-range certificate must precede any benchmark spend.
General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a prerequisite that fails with an identical signature across independent lanes has one shared cause to repair once, not N independent rediscoveries.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): locally rational continuation is a documented failure mode; a lane left on its own next_question drifts toward incremental refinements of a spent thread (local attractor).

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): end-to-end agent cost is dominated by exploration, verification and repair rather than stored-representation size, favoring counter-based work-avoided metrics over latency proxies.
General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a single-vantage / single-substrate positive deserves external-validity testing before it is used as a product or architectural prior.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. The historical composition/paraphrase work (P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION, pre2 product summary artifact 4.697, sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda: 3/3 vs 0/3 with keyword/oracle dependence and weak baselines; Mind2Web V0.50 archived Codex section 1: retrieval 47/176, exact human route 6/176) is explicitly rated too weak to constitute evidence and never tested independent goal authoring, whole-registry contamination screens, or calibrated abstention. Not a pointless rerun: the R2 45/52-vs-33/52 measurement is bounded but confounded because intents and goal templates were authored in the same execute-time file by the same agent; this allocation removes that specific confound rather than re-running the same design.
allocation.question: On a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application whose goal texts are authored by a process that never sees the mechanism intent strings, with a preregistered contamination screen measuring every goal's overlap against EVERY registry intent, a preregistered authoring-provenance record, a reference arm provably distinct from the candidate, and positive/null/dynamic-range controls each arithmetically able to fail and live-verified before freeze: does max-cosine-similarity selection over intent embeddings still bind the correct mechanism on goals never seen at authoring time, and by how much does it exceed a token-overlap null on those same independently authored goals - i.e., does the bounded 45/52 vs 33/52 advantage (paired family-blocked difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136, 0.3509]) survive removal of the joint-authorship confound, with abstention scored as its own class, pooled false-accept <= 0.10, UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85 and ECE <= 0.15?
allocation.rationale: Graph is tunnel-flagged on C-FRESHNESS (7/10 recent) and its last accepted verdict PARKED the four-anchor Part II route; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is a neglected, central claim ('resolve' is a step of the product abstraction) whose entire recent R2 history is either MEASUREMENT_INVALID or under an explicit joint-authorship confound. Cognitive reset: if Graph encountered today's Codex fresh, the highest-decision-value question is whether semantic resolution actually works on independently authored goals, because that determines whether the resolve step is real or an artifact of co-authoring. Removing the confound before adding mechanisms is the correct causal-identification step and directly targets the registry next_gate (unseen-goal resolution with calibrated abstention).

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 436 canonical experiments. Effective claim state: C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED at the bounded authorship-separated real-Chromium scope (EXP-RUNTIME-36293257855); C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS. No experiment yet establishes a net end-to-end cost reduction per successful partially novel Web task for a real external LLM agent against cold/instructions/retrieval at the same model/tools/budget, and the shipped src/spider/kernel.py still lacks distill_parameterized() while its literal candidates are born at confidence 0.5 below the default 0.8 execution threshold. The three verified product blockers standing: B1 no promoted parameterized carrier; B2 benchmark degeneracy (cold/retrieval at the 1.0 correctness ceiling on the deterministic credential-free REST class); B3 agent capability/economics unresolved (0/5 on tested local 3B/7B endpoints). All six lanes already hold a just-issued prefreeze mandate (allocated ~07:23Z this cycle window) that maps directly onto those blockers and onto the strongest under-verified claims: Product -> B1 shipped-carrier promotion certificate; Runtime -> B2 non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank; Intel -> B3 endpoint-capability probe; Graph -> C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE joint-authorship confound removal; Physics -> C-WEB-DYNAMICS second-egress vantage transfer; Frontier -> depth/hop fresh-instance acquisition-cost measurement. Branch inspection shows five of the six in-flight mandates are stalled at the SAME design-review step with the SAME failure fingerprint (3b9ff5e4e9e73f23e368efb4, model opencode/exo-free, exit 1, category substantive): this is a shared control-plane/model-routing outage (the same class of outage that degraded the Scout, rc=124), NOT five independent scientific design defects, and it is outside lane edit scope. Decision: CONTINUE every lane's in-flight mandate unchanged (no pivots, no re-aims), preserving the prefreeze transactions; flag the design-review model outage as the single highest-priority operational blocker to be repaired once in infrastructure; and do NOT fund the gated C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON four-arm execution this cycle (none of the three readiness conditions yet holds).
